# Lemonsky USD, Asset Export

This tool helps artists export asset geometries to USD files.

# Interface / Controls

![][image1]

## Controls

1. Export Geometry Variants \- To use this feature user has to append both variants into the “Selected Asset” box and check the “Export Geometry Variants” check box, refer below.  
   ![][image2]  
     
2. Export Material Variants \- To use this feature the user has to attach a shader into aiSwitch, refer below. Assign the aiSwitch to the geometry.  
   ![][image3]  
     
3. Write USD as Binary \-  99% of the time, export as binary should be checked. Unless instructed to have it checked off.   
4. Export MASH Network \- If any asset uses a MASH network, this check box should be checked. 

## Adding Assets into “Selected Assets” box

1. Users can drag and drop selected assets into the box.  
2. Users can select assets in the outliner, then click “Append Selection”

### 

### Excepted Assets

1. Export follows a strict outliner structure, of which if the USD Import Asset Controller was used, the asset would simply be qualified. Any asset of a Geometry parent. See below.  
   ![][image4]

## Export

1. Export \- Export button to run the export process. 

## Workflow

1. Exporter controls versioning by default. Executing the export process will automatically version up assets that are listed in the “Selected Assets” box. If users do not wish to version up an asset, simply exclude. The export process will keep the previous version as a backup in a version folder.
